denied.title: Restricted access
denied.list: The catalogue is reserved for salon accounts. Ask your administrator for access.
denied.newService: Creating a service is reserved for the salon’s managers and administrators.
denied.service: Editing the catalogue is reserved for managers and administrators.
denied.categories: Catalogue sections are reserved for salon accounts.

list.title: Service catalogue

toolbar.restricted: Creating and editing services are reserved for the manager rank.

empty.title: Empty catalogue
empty.activeManager: Every service of the salon is disabled: the public page offers none. Remove the filter to find them and re-enable one.
empty.activeReader: Every service of the salon is disabled: the public page offers none. Remove the filter to find them — re-enabling one is reserved for the manager rank.
empty.manager: Create your first service so the salon’s public page has something to book.
empty.reader: No service is registered: the salon’s public page has nothing to book. Creating a service is reserved for the manager rank.

caption.all: Services of the salon, active and disabled.

list.inactiveStaff: No active practitioner — no slot bookable online

service-created.title: Service “{subject}” created
service-created.body: It will only be offered for booking once a practitioner is assigned.

appointment-booked.title: New appointment: {subject}
appointment-booked.body: It has just landed on the planning.

appointment-cancelled.title: Appointment on {subject} cancelled by the client
appointment-cancelled.body: The slot is offered for booking again.

newService.title: New service
newService.restrictedBody: Creating a service is reserved for the manager rank. The catalogue stays readable, and a manager or an administrator of the salon can add the service for you. <link>Back to the catalogue</link>.

service.occupiedHint: Blocks {duration} on the agenda, buffers included.
service.notFoundBody: No service of this salon carries that identifier. It may have been created in another establishment.

categories.title: Catalogue sections
categories.hint: A section groups services on the public page. It is disabled, it is not deleted — reporting must keep knowing under which section a sale was made.
categories.categoryHint: A disabled section leaves the public page; the services it groups stay in the catalogue.
categories.notFoundBody: No section of this salon carries that identifier. It may have been created in another establishment.

preview.title: Preview of the public rendering
preview.unavailableHint: The salon’s public page could not be read.
preview.noticeScope: Only active services, classified under an active section, appear here. Preparation and turnaround buffers are not shown: they describe the salon’s internal pace.
preview.noticeUnstaffed: An active service that no practitioner performs still appears, with the mention “{unstaffed}” in place of the names: the availability engine will offer no slot for it. The card only counts practitioners whose account is active — assign a practitioner from its record, or re-enable the one already listed there under the mention “{disabled}”.

form.savedBody: The public catalogue now reflects this information.

form.name: Service name
form.descriptionHint: Shown on the public page, under the service name. Optional.
form.categoryHint: Groups the service on the public page. “Unclassified” is a valid choice.
form.durationHint: What the client sees and pays for, buffers excluded.
form.bufferBeforeHint: Getting the room ready. Invisible to the client, busy on the agenda.
form.bufferAfterHint: Putting the room back in order. Invisible to the client, busy on the agenda.
form.occupied: Time blocked on the agenda: {duration} — treatment duration and buffers included.
form.priceHint: Currency of the establishment. A complimentary treatment is worth 0.
form.slugHintNew: Leave it empty: it will be derived from the name. Worth filling in to pin down a link already shared.
form.slugHintEdit: The deep link to this service. Changing it breaks the links already shared.
form.restricted: Editing the catalogue is reserved for the manager rank.
